Welcome! This page collects everything from the workshop: the slides, the
take-home notebooks, and the reading list. Nothing here requires an R
installation — you can read all materials right in your browser and set up R
whenever you like.

The [bmm](https://cran.r-project.org/package=bmm) (Bayesian Measurement
Models) R package lets you fit cognitive measurement models — signal
detection, working-memory measurement, drift diffusion — with a model-first
interface: you specify the cognitive model, bmm handles the translation to
Bayesian hierarchical estimation in Stan.

## Run the materials yourself (optional)

1. Install [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) (≥ 4.3) and
   [RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) or
   [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/).
2. Download the workshop repository:
   <https://github.com/GidonFrischkorn/ShortWS_CognitiveModelling_bmm>
3. Open `ShortWS_CognitiveModelling_bmm.Rproj`, then run
   `source("Install_Packages.R")` once and `source("Check_Setup.R")` to
   verify everything works.

Every model shown in the workshop ships pre-fitted in `models/`, so **you do
not need the Stan toolchain** — the notebooks load cached fits and run in
seconds.
